cards.question: What does Arc stand for?
cards.answer: Atomically Reference Counted. It is like Rc, but increment and decrement of the count are atomic.

cards.question: Why can Arc be sent across threads?
cards.answer: No two threads can mutate the count at the same time, so the pointer can be safely shared and sent across threads.

cards.question: How do you inspect or uniquely mutate an Arc?
cards.answer: Arc::strong_count gives the number of references. Arc::get_mut yields a mutable reference when the Arc is unique.
